lints.name: auth_rls_initplan
lints.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
lints.description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row

findings.detail: Table \`public.creators\` has a row level security policy \`creators_self\` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing \`auth.<function>()\` with \`(select auth.<function>())\`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

lints.name: multiple_permissive_policies
lints.title: Multiple Permissive Policies
lints.description: Detects if multiple permissive row level security policies are present on a table for the same \`role\` and \`action\` (e.g. insert). Multiple permissive policies are suboptimal for performance as each policy must be executed for every relevant query.

findings.detail: Table \`public.campaign_participants\` has multiple permissive policies for role \`authenticated\` for action \`SELECT\`. Policies include \`{campaign_participants_brand_select,campaign_participants_self_read}\`
Table \`public.missions\` has multiple permissive policies for role \`authenticated\` for action \`SELECT\`. Policies include \`{missions_brand_select,missions_workspace}\`
